description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Ice Resonance +5% Boost], and [Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Reynn)] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode I (Reynn)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Ice abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Ice abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants smart ether 1, [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Reynn)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ice Mode II (Reynn)
description.text: Ice abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts speed x9999999 for Ice abilities, chases Ice abilities with Dual Nosenose Summoner (max 1)

description.name: Dual Nosenose Summoner
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)], [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] and grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies if 4+ summoner allies are alive, causes [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)] and [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] if 0-3 summoner allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 20% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], [Imperil Water 20% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3
